  "text": "The constable lifted his left foot. Its heel was worn to the same crooked crescent.

“I’ve never seen this place,” he said.

From the passage came the scrape of a boot being dragged over stone. Once. Then again.

Venn took the ledger from Elias and pushed it into the opening. The scratching beneath its cover ceased. A moment later, something farther down the passage began scratching instead.

“First light,” Mara said. “How long?”

Elias checked his watch. Its hands stood at six, though it had been nearly midnight when they entered the house. He held it to his ear and shook his head.

Ada stepped over the threshold. The bootprints ended three paces in, where the dust gave way to bare stone. Beyond that, water shone in shallow pools. She could hear someone breathing ahead of her, careful and quiet.

Behind her, the cellar door slammed. Elias cried out. Ada turned and saw that the seam in the wall was closing. Mara caught the edge with both hands, but the stone kept moving.

“Come through!” Ada called.

The constable squeezed past Mara, then Elias. Venn stayed behind, bracing the ledger against the narrowing gap. Its cover swelled around his fingers.

“Venn.” Ada reached for him.

He thrust the ledger toward her. “Find out whose handwriting that is.”

Ada pulled it free. The stone sealed before Venn could follow.

In the dark, the constable struck a match. On the page beneath the date, a fresh line appeared. Ada watched each letter take shape: VENN WILL OPEN THE DOOR."
